answer.description: The single correct option letter. NONE only when the question cannot be answered from what is given.

confidence.description: certain: the answer follows unambiguously from established knowledge and the material shown. probable: very likely but one other option is defensible. uncertain: genuinely unclear.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences: why this answer is right and why the strongest distractor is wrong.

solvable.description: False if the question depends on something missing, garbled, or contradictory.

issue.description: Empty string if none. Otherwise name the defect: missing diagram, ambiguous stem, two defensible answers, OCR damage, etc.
